title.zh: 将蒙廷卢帕市与拉斯皮纳斯市马尼拉南路萨波特-阿拉邦段更名为费利蒙·C·阿吉拉尔众议员大道，以纪念已故众议员费利蒙·C·阿吉拉尔的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Manila South-Road, Zapote-Alabang Section in the City of Muntinlupa and City of Las Pinas, Metro Manila, to Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar Avenue in Honor of the Late Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Manila South-Road, Zapote-Alabang Section in the City of Muntinlupa and City of Las Pinas, Metro Manila, to Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar Avenue in Honor of the Late Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8714_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Hereafter, the Manila South-Road, Zapote-Alabang Section in the City of Muntinlupa and City of Las Pinas, Metro Manila, shall be known as Felimon C. Aguilar Avenue in honor of the late Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar of the Lone District of Las Pinas/Muntinlupa.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
